summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory actions impacting the retail sector, particularly concerning tariffs and price adjustments.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court ruled welfare of child can't be the sole reason for ordering a paternity test.
Indian customs detained Scotch shipments from Pernod Ricard and Diageo, seeking a 150% tariff instead of 75% under the India-UK trade pact.
Mother Dairy raised milk prices by Rs 2-4 per litre effective November 12 due to higher procurement costs.
India's Q2 FY27 GDP growth is estimated at 7.8%, with GVA growth expected between 8-8.2%, according to SBI Research.
IBA Next Gen Legal Summit scheduled in New Delhi on November 27, focusing on future legal practices.
